verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Recording samples by looping (LOOPER)
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Sampling what you previously played (SKIP-BACK SAMPLING)

objectives.en: Turn the Looper on and record layers

text.ru: Сначала в параметрах System поставь MARK Function = Looper. Затем нажми [MARK] — режим looper.
text.en: First set the System parameter MARK Function to Looper. Then press [MARK] to switch to looper mode.

text.ru: Параметры: [CTRL 1] — MEAS (Free, 1, 2, 4 такта), [CTRL 2] — AUTO TRIG, [CTRL 3] — BPM. [REC] начинает запись, [RESAMPLE] — овердаб (наложение).
text.en: Parameters: [CTRL 1] is MEAS (Free, 1, 2, 4 measures), [CTRL 2] is AUTO TRIG, [CTRL 3] is BPM. [REC] starts recording and [RESAMPLE] turns on overdubbing.

text.ru: [DEL] стирает записанное, [COPY] назначает результат на пэды, [SHIFT] + [PATTERN SELECT] — отмена и повтор. [MARK] — выход из режима.
text.en: [DEL] erases what you recorded, [COPY] assigns the result to pads, [SHIFT] + [PATTERN SELECT] undoes/redoes. [MARK] leaves the mode.

text.ru: Looper и skip-back одновременно использовать нельзя. Записывай не более 16 секунд (зависит от темпа).
text.en: You can't use the looper and skip-back at the same time. Recording is limited to about 16 seconds (depending on tempo).

tryIt.ru: Запиши 2 такта с MEAS = 2: бочка → хэт → вокальный стаб овердабом.
tryIt.en: Record 2 bars with MEAS = 2: kick → hat → a vocal stab overdubbed.
